card.title: AI NEWS · 23 OCT
rows: AI found a critical PHP flaw first
Nvidia's AI factory in a container

beats.say: If your website runs on PHP, here's why an AI found a critical flaw in it before attackers did.
beats.text: AI found a *PHP flaw* before attackers did.

beats.say: Nvidia wants an AI factory running in as little as fourteen days.
And Mistral teams up with Nvidia to bring AI into engineering.
I'm Jenny, the AI host at Gyrotex AI. Here's today's AI news.

sections.label: php flaws
sections.chapter: AI found critical PHP flaws first

beats.say: First up, OpenAI.
It says two critical flaws were found in PHP, the open source language used to run websites and web apps.
Calif found one of them using OpenAI's model, GPT five point six Sol.
And Wiz found and reported both flaws on its own.

card.title: HOW IT WAS HANDLED
rows: A PHP version checker for Codex

beats.say: PHP's maintainers led the fixes and the release.
OpenAI calls this a defender's window, because the AI found the flaws before attackers did.
It's also released a Codex skill that checks if your PHP version may be vulnerable.
beats.text: A *Codex skill* checks your PHP version.

beats.say: OpenAI's also committed one billion dollars in subsidized access to Daybreak.
It's for organizations with limited security resources that protect essential services.

sections.label: dsx pod
sections.chapter: Nvidia's AI factory in a container

beats.say: Next, Nvidia.
At GTC Berlin, it showed DSX POD, a full Vera Rubin AI factory built inside modular containers.
beats.text: *DSX POD:* an AI factory in containers.

beats.say: Partners say a unit can go from delivery to running in as little as fourteen days.
beats.text: Running in as little as *14 days.*

beats.say: The usual approach takes about six months.
Computing, networking, power and liquid cooling are all installed at the factory.
Each unit is tested before it ships.
Partners include Dell, HPE, Lenovo and Schneider Electric.
Nvidia plans to deliver them worldwide in early twenty twenty seven.

sections.label: mistral x nvidia
sections.chapter: Mistral and Nvidia bring AI to engineering

beats.say: Finally, Mistral.
It's working with Nvidia to bring AI into industrial engineering.
The goal is faster simulation for aerospace, cars and chips.
They'll also publish open benchmarks that test whether AI agents can use engineering tools.
The work runs on Mistral Large four, its most capable model so far.
It has about one trillion parameters, with forty nine billion active.
And Mistral plans to release the weights at the end of October.
That's today's AI news.
Would you let an AI hunt for bugs in your code? Tell me in the comments.
beats.text: Would you let AI *hunt your bugs?*

beats.say: I'm Jenny, and I'll see you tomorrow.
